items.evidence: leverage play work --ticks 5 --settings <scratch>: printed one JSON object, screen title, with tick, screen, menu_index, language, volume, difficulty, texts, score, best, coins, wave, gate_health, guard_y, quick, heavy, saved, enemies, bolts.
play --ticks 6290 ... --frame play.png --size 800x480 wrote a PNG; header reads 800 x 480 RGBA.

Fresh place: texts [Hold the gate: the long night, Best: 0, Start, Settings, Quit], saved false. 1:enter -> tick 2 screen play, wave 1, score 0, coins 0, gate_health 10, texts 'Wave 1 of 8', 'Gate: 10'.

Settings: right x4 from 8 gave 9,10,10,10; left x11 gave 0 and stayed at 0; language en->es->fr and stays fr, left from en stays en; difficulty normal by default, left to easy (stays), right to normal then hard (stays).

In es and fr, the texts on title, settings, play, shop, paused, won (a full 8-wave run) and lost were all translated (e.g. 'Oleada 1 de 8', 'Vague 1 sur 8', 'Has ganado', 'Vous avez perdu', 'En pausa', 'Reprendre', 'Continuar'); only the game name stays English.
Run 1 set volume 0 and Hard (another place: fr, volume 9); a second run with the same --settings started with volume 0/hard (and fr/9); a fresh folder started with en, 8, normal.
10:up -> guard_y 6.1 at tick 11, 12 at tick 70 (stays 12); down from tick 80: 11.9 at 81, 6 at 140, 0 at 200. That is 0.1 per tick = 6 units/s, held to 0..12.
Shoot held from tick 2: bolts appear at x=2 on ticks 3, 27, 51 (every 24); a bolt moves 0.233 per tick (14/s); a bolt at 19.708 at tick 304 is gone later, and none stays past x=20.
Idle wave 1 (seed 1): walkers enter at x=20 on ticks 3, 93, 183, 273, 363 (90 ticks apart) in lanes 2,4,8,6,6, health 2, x drops 0.025 per tick (1.5/s); 5 walkers, then the shop.
Shooting in lane 6: a walker in lane 6 goes from health 2 to 1, then is gone, with score 0->10 and coins 0->1; bolts in lane 6 pass the lane-2 walker, which keeps health 2.

Idle: gate 10->9 at tick 803 when walker 1 reaches x=0, and it is removed; score and coins stay 0. Hard idle run: gate 1 -> 0 at tick 1869, screen lost, texts [You lost, Score: 50, Best: 50, Enter: title].
Difficulty easy then Start: gate_health 14, 'Gate: 14'. Hard then Start: gate_health 7.

Wave 1 idle: at tick 1163 screen shop, enemies [], with the state the same at 1163-1300; texts [Shop, Coins: 0, Next: wave 2 of 8, Quick hands - 5 coins - level 0 of 2, Heavy bolts - 12 coins - level 0 of 1, Mason - 4 coins - gate +3, Next wave].

After buying Quick hands with 5 coins (5->0), held shoot fired bolts on ticks 481, 499, 517 (18 apart). After level 2 (16->6 coins), ticks 2821, 2833, 2845 (12 apart). A third Enter on Quick hands (full): coins 6, quick 2, unchanged.
Heavy bought (17->5 coins). In wave 4 a walker with health 2 is gone after one hit (score +10), and a brute goes 6->4->2. A second Enter on Heavy bolts: coins 6, heavy 1, unchanged.
Gate 9, coins 4: Mason gives gate 10 (not 12), coins 0. Gate 8, coins 3: Enter on Mason leaves coins 3 and gate 8. Gate 10 (full), coins 6: Enter on Mason leaves coins 6 and gate 10.

Next wave entered at 471 -> play at 472 with enemies [] and 'Wave 2 of 8'; the first walker appears at x=20 on tick 532 (60 later). Wave 2 sent 7 walkers (532 to 1072, 90 apart), then the shop. es: 'Oleada 2 de 8'.
Wave 3: 6 walkers from 1287, then runners at 1719, 1791, 1863, 1935 (72 ticks = 1.2 s), health 1, x falls 0.05 per tick (3/s); a runner kill took score 180->195 and coins 13->14.
Wave 4: 8 walkers then a brute at 2657, health 6, x falls 0.017 per tick (1/s). Killed: score 320->360, coins 13->16. Left alone in a variant: gate 10->7 when it reached x=0, and no points.
modules/work/waves.json has 8 entries {walkers, runners, brutes, every}, included by lib.rs; the README section 'Change a wave' says how to edit it. The waves I saw match the file.

Full scripted run, seed 1, all 88 enemies destroyed: tick 6552 screen won, score 1540 = 1340 enemy points + 20 x 10 gate; texts [You won, Score: 1,540, Best: 1,540, Enter: title]; Enter at 6560 -> title at 6561.

Escape at 50 -> paused, and enemies, bolts and guard stay the same through 300 ticks; Title (down, Enter) -> title. But Enter on Resume (menu_index 0) leaves the screen paused at every later tick (tested 3 times). Only Escape resumes.
Shop open at tick 456 -> saved true, settings.json kept.saved filled. The next run with the same place shows texts [name, Best: 0, Start, Continue, Settings, Quit] (from tick 1).
Saved after buying Quick hands (wave 1, score 50, coins 0, gate 10, quick 1). Continue -> shop with exactly those values; Next wave -> play 'Wave 2 of 8', score 50, first walker 60 ticks later.

Start with a saved run -> saved false, and the next run has no Continue. A lost run (saved true before) -> saved false at lost. A won run -> saved false. Title from the pause in wave 2 -> Continue still there in the next run, and kept.saved is still the wave-1 shop.
Lost with 50 (best 0): the lost screen and the next title show 'Best: 50'. A later lost run with 0 keeps 'Best: 50'. Won with 1540: the won screen and the next title show 'Best: 1,540'.
Two runs, seed 7, same ticks and script, from identical copies of a kept folder: outputs byte-identical (cmp). Seed 8: enemies in lanes 6,6,2 instead of 2,2,4.

Frame at tick 6290 (wave 8): the gate bar on the left, the blue guard at (2,10), a green walker at (8.25,4), small yellow runners at (13.3,10) and (15.7,8), a big red brute at (19.35,10), and 4 bolts at the x the state gives (40 px/unit). The HUD shows Score 1,140, Coins 66, Wave 8 of 8, Gate 10.

Title frame in Spanish with Continuar focused (outlined), settings frame in French with Langue focused, shop frame in Spanish with Albanil focused: each shows its menu in that language with the chosen entry outlined.
assets/strings/en.json, es.json, fr.json each hold every string; screens use @keys. The README section 'Add a language' says to copy en.json to <code>.json and translate it.

The README has how to play, where everything is kept (the --settings folder's settings.json: settings, kept.best, kept.saved), and the headless and frame commands. Run with my own settings and frame paths, both worked as written.

defects: Pause menu: Enter on Resume does nothing (its action 'resume' never reaches the rules); only Escape resumes.
At tick 0 a saved run is not yet known to the rules, so a script input at tick 0 sees no Continue on the title (the README admits this).
A bolt cannot hit an enemy that has passed x = 2 (the README admits this).
The README commands use --settings ./kept and --frame frame.png relative to work/, so running them exactly as written writes into the game folder; I used scratch paths with the same flags.
